scenario: A single correlation's Bedrock spend crosses its $1.00 per-correlation cap mid-turn.
notes: phase-16 §3.1 + §5 step 3: budget_gate.check_startable raises before invoke_agent; PrimeSupervisor.ask catches it and answers INCONCLUSIVE with reason 'request budget exceeded' instead of propagating.

scenario: One principal's cumulative spend for the day is already within a slow_multi estimate of the $50/day cap.
notes: phase-16 §3.2: the daily-principal ledger (synthetic correlation key daily#<principal>#<date>) is checked independently of the per-correlation cap; a fresh correlation with zero prior spend of its own still gets rejected because its principal is capped for the day.

scenario: The bedrock circuit breaker has tripped open (3 throttles within 60s) before a new correlation starts.
notes: phase-16 §5 step 5: breaker check runs before either cost check in check_startable -- a suspect cost signal behind a tripped breaker should never be trusted enough to reach the dollar-cap comparison.

scenario: A misbehaving specialist attempts 100 Bedrock action-group tool calls within one correlation.
notes: phase-16 §8 acceptance criterion verbatim: 'an agent tries to make 100 Bedrock calls; halted at cap 30'. Exercised as test_runaway_agent_halted_at_tool_invocation_cap in tests/unit/test_budget_gate.py.

scenario: A specialist requests Sonnet at 50% of the correlation's dollar cap and has flagged its task downgrade_ok=true.
notes: phase-16 §5 step 8, 25-70% tier: downgrade only happens when the specialist opts in; the same input with downgrade_ok=false must keep sonnet (test_pick_model_downgrade_ok_tier in adapters/tests/unit/test_model_router.py).

scenario: A specialist requests Sonnet at 71% of the correlation's dollar cap.
notes: phase-16 §5 step 8, >70% tier: Haiku is forced regardless of request_hint or downgrade_ok -- the caller's preference stops mattering past this point.

scenario: Two correlations spend against two different principals and features across fast and slow_multi modes in the same ISO week.
notes: phase-16 §5 step 7: exercised as test_build_report_produces_all_five_breakdowns in tests/unit/test_cost_report.py; report key published as cost/{year}-W{week}.json per adapters/tests/unit/test_reports_client.py's existing contract.
